notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update Information
notes.content:
- Regarding volume adjustment, when the sound is changed from a muted state to a sound with sound, the sound is played immediately.
- Fixed a bug that caused the turn to end without the "Board" command being displayed when adjacent to both enemy and friendly bases after moving the player's ship.
- Other minor changes have been made to the messages displayed during the game.
